snippet.title: Geamana Village - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Step into Geamana Village, an atmospheric first-person investigative game where you play as Moloce Arcip, a former journalist searching for redemption.

Explore the remains of a drowned village buried beneath toxic waters. Photograph ruins, interview the last locals, uncover forgotten documents, and piece together a story long erased by time and silence.

Wishlist Geamana Village on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3815000/Geamana_Village/
